## Why this folder exists separately

The working LaTeX in `thesis/latex_tum_official/` has been **edited after submission**
(`03_methodology.tex` and `05_results.tex` were changed on 28 Aug 2026), and its
`main.pdf` is 674,395 bytes — a different document from the one submitted.

Every chapter and page file differs between the two versions. If you need to know what
was examined, read this folder, not the working copy.

Recovered from `_legacy/zamin_thesis_submission/` during the repository consolidation
on 1 Sep 2026. Original file timestamps (14 May 2026) are preserved.
